reviews.text:
I cannot say enough positive things about Mindful Pups. Dina, the owner possesses so much knowledge about Dog Care and safety. She is beyond talented at understanding a dog and training it successfully with love and care! She is also quite gifted with people. This talent helps her not only train the dog, but make it possible for the family to continue training the dog at home. She raised our puppy for us with a board and training program and will continue to help us train her to be the best family dog ever!
There is nothing else like her programming in the city! She understands what it’s like to have a dog in Brooklyn and helps your dog adapt to that city life as well as the family adapt to having a dog. I highly recommend any of the Mindful Pups services!

Mindful Pups has helped us so much since adopting our GSP mix puppy. We thought we had done all the research needed for a high-energy, working dog mix, but two weeks after bringing her home, we felt completely lost and defeated. Then we found Mindful Pups and Dina and her team have been wonderful! Our pup completed the two-week puppy intensive and made such great progress. We learned how to properly structure her day, and the team helped her learn to nap and sleep comfortably in her crate, which was a big problem for us before. She still occasionally goes to the studio for puppy day training, and they do an amazing job organizing the program. She gets the individual attention she needs as a puppy while also being slowly and thoughtfully introduced to group environments. They work with each dog on what they need specifically; it's not your regular day care where the dogs just run around and play all day. We are so thankful to have found Mindful Pups, and the best part is that our puppy absolutely LOVES coming here too!
Couldn’t do it without Dina and mindful pups. The pickup and dropoff service for daily day care is amazing. And the puppy bootcamp was priceless.

Dina at Mindful Pups is exceptionally responsive, knowledgeable, and simply wonderful to work with. She helps new owners gain the confidence needed to get on the right track for a great life with your dog. Thank you Dina!!

We love Mindful Pups! The day after we brought home our new puppy, we had a home visit from a Mindful Pups trainer and it gave us all the tools we needed to start raising a relaxed, confident and sweet dog. (We’d read numerous books on the topic. A single Mindful Pups visit was worth more than all of them combined.) Over the next two months, the guidance from Mindful Pups shaped everything we did, from his sleep schedule and crate training to chewing prevention, the use of positive reinforcement, potty training, teaching “come” “sit” “down” and “leave it,” beginning leash training and, overall, helping him become a calm and confident city dog, comfortable with sirens, horns, and crowds.

At three-and-a-half months, Jasper took the two-week puppy intensive. He's reached a new level of calm and confidence, especially in his interactions with other dogs, his leash manners and his patience (who knew a puppy could be patient?!?!?). Mindful Pups posted daily Instagram stories of our pup-in-training—which were not only adorable, but helped teach us, his humans, too! (This program was more than worth the price—and I don’t think there’s anything else like it in NYC.)

What stands out most: the Mindful Pups team doesn't just love dogs. They understand canine behavior and use that knowledge to tailor a program to each individual pup. Before Jasper started the program, we were nervous about sending him to any sort of daycare or boarding facility. (We'd heard about dangerous situations at some local places.) But Mindful Pups, and the focus on training, is truly unique. We now know each of the trainers by name. It was clear from the start that they are, indeed, mindful — assessing and teaching each dog individually, according to temperament, behavior and life stage. We feel 100% confident of his safety with them. Nothing is left to chance. We are so grateful to have joined their community. Would give them ten stars if we could!

As a first-time puppy and dog owner, I was utterly overwhelmed and had absolutely no clue where to start with our Jaba. When Dina came over for a training session, she was like an interpreter for not only my husband and me, but for our two kids, too. She empowered all of us with concrete tools to communicate with and to Jaba. I also attended the Puppy class with my 8-year-old and it was transformative in our ability to manage Jaba's schedule and needs and make it so much easier. Mindful Pups put Jaba on a schedule which we still follow to this day and ensures that Jaba is rested and so that we have a structure to our day. He attended a Mindful Pups two-week puppy class where he learned basic things like threshold training (not racing through a door), how to interact with other dogs, and most importantly how to calmly handle the incredibly over-stimulating environment of our Brooklyn neighborhood and home, with two boys constantly at play.
I really cannot say enough good things about Mindful Pups. We feel so lucky we can work with them!

We did a three week intensive board and train with Dina for our nine month rescue puppy and it was transformative. Due to exercise and play restrictions after a bone fracture, our puppy had missed some key socialization windows, and she was anxious and very reactive to other dogs on walks. Dina took on the challenge without hesitation and worked with us to understand Scooby's specific personality and needs. By sending dozens of videos during the board and train, Dina helped us understand Scooby's body language, her fears, and her needs. She showed us in each video what she was doing to help Scooby work through her challenges. We still have ongoing training to do, but we feel so much more prepared and equipped to deal with everythng and help Scooby be confident and successful both at home and in the world. Dina, Sam, and all the trainers at Mindful Pups clearly love what they are doing and bring so much joy to the process. They have already helped us so much. We're looking forward to completing more training sessions and continuing to make progress. Highly recommend.

We had such a wonderful experience with Mindful Pups. Dina paired us with Jojo to work with our dog, Remi, on her reactivity toward people. We honestly felt a little bit hopeless, but Jojo totally changed the way we viewed and handled reactivity. Now we all have more confidence and understand how to advocate for Remi but also make her feel safe enough to handle occasional greetings with strangers. We are so thankful!

Just one session with Dina and I already feel so much more hopeful about our training journey. My 1.5-year-old dog, Sonny, has elbow dysplasia, which means he lives a very physically restricted life. He’s often sore, uncomfortable, and understandably frustrated that he can’t run and play with other dogs the way he’d like. Our current issues are obedience (because we let him get away with too much because of his elbow issues) and anxiety and confidence.

One of the hardest parts is that you can’t simply ask your dog how they’re feeling. Dina has already helped us better understand Sonny’s needs, emotions, and frustrations in a way that’s difficult to put into words. Her compassion, knowledge, and insight have given us a whole new perspective, and I can’t wait to continue working with her to help Sonny navigate his challenges and live the happiest life possible.

Dina and her team at Mindful Pups took great care of Winnie and she came back with the skills and training that we hoped for when she left for her Board & Train. Highly recommend! Winnie looks forward to returning in the future for boarding and reinforcement training. Thank you!!

I cannot recommend Mindful more highly. It is one of the best decisions we ever made. The daycare is run like a posh preschool - they provide so much structure and variety for each dog. And they tailor the day to meet each dog where they are. My dog prefers more solo chill time during free play so they set him up with a cozy corner to rest in. Their day train program is phenomenal. Every dog gets their own training blocks and the challenges are created to build confidence in the dogs and help them "make good choices" as Dina says. We also had the opportunity to do a several weeks long board and train. Our dog Kermit learned so much, he is like a whole different dog now - much calmer, and so much happier. He's not a puppy, and yet they were able to shift hard-wired behaviors, like freaking out in a car, barking at guests, and refusing to sleep in a crate. Now, Kermit chills during car rides, accepts guests in our house, and sleeps all night in his crate. The post boarding training sessions that I have had with Dina have helped me feel confident in continuing to reinforce all the good work she and Lucca did with him. So I can also say that Dina trained me well, too! Five plus stars!!

It would be hard for me to overstate how amazing Dina and everyone at MindfulPups have been.  It was clear from the minute our first session started that she is the woman you want helping you.  Moreover, you can tell that she loves every second of it.  In what seems like no time at all, we went from a pup that nipped at us, had accidents in the house, and barked everytime we went down the hallway, to a dog that is obedient, fully house trained, rarely barks, doesn't nip, and can sleep in his crate overnight.  Most importantly he is confident and happy.  If you're looking for training in Brooklyn, this is your spot.

Mindful Pups has truly been a transformative experience for our rescue puppy, Millie, and our family. I can't say enough good things about Dina, Luca, Sam and all the trainers who have worked so beautifully with Millie. We feel we hit the jackpot by finding them and can't imagine sending Millie anywhere else.
We initially were looking for training because Millie needed help with her impulse control and her very real FOMO/distractibility issues - it meant she couldn't always really focus with us and could get overstimulated easily. Dina and the trainers quickly understood her needs and her personality and were able to tailor the training very specifically to help Millie overcome some of these challenges. By the end of her 2 week intensive, Millie has shown amazing growth: she is able to focus more, to self soothe and to remain calm for much longer periods of time. This has made a world of difference in her self-confidence and our family now has better tools to keep working on the skills she has developed at Mindful Pups.
Most importantly, Millie has really loved going to Mindful Pups during her 2 week intensive. She couldn't wait to get there and get to work. It truly felt like taking a toddler to preschool who loves seeing their teacher! She loves every single trainer she has worked with - it speaks to their care, attentiveness, and the love they bring to their work. They were able to build trust with her so quickly and she was comfortable working with different people seamlessly.
We hope Millie can continue to attend Mindful Pup's daycare. She comes home happy and fulfilled, and there's nothing better than hearing the contented sigh of a puppy who has had a good day.
I can't recommend Dina and Mindful Pups and the whole crew highly enough!

I can't express how much I love Mindful Pups.  We got a new rescue pup last year... after 15 years of a doggo who was more potato than dog.  And you forget how HARD training a puppy is.  It's not for the faint of heart! Our pup Jonathan LOVES Dina and everyone at Mindful Pups (especially Samanta, Fiona, and Khaleesi). He loves his days at daycare so much that every time we walk on Union he wants to go in.  We love the daily insta account so you can keep tabs on the pups while they're there. Our pup recently had a leg injury and was on restricted activity and Dina and team were able to accommodate and it was a real life saver.

Dina knew almost immediately what was missing in my dog's life and why she had been "misbehaving" and gave easy-to-follow suggestions to increase my dog's fulfillment and happiness. Results were immediate. Highly recommend

A friend recommended Dina and we contacted her when we knew we wanted to adopt for a quick consultation, and then again when we got our rescue pup Sandy. She was able to work with us to set up our first training appt ASAP. It was a relief to meet Dina and get tips and insights so we got off to a good start with this new 6 month old pup! Dina was super clear and showed us do-able ways to start this process, including my children in the process of learning to interact with and train Sandy. We feel more confident after the session and are looking forward to more and to being part of the Mindful Pups community!

I contacted Dina within days of adopting my 4-month-old pup to help us get on the same page and give me the tools to address some concerning habits (esp. biting).  In one session, I already feel FAR more comfortable and confident.  I cannot recommend Dina highly enough!

I was totally overwhelmed when I got my beautiful, amazing but exhausting new puppy Remy, and so I am so thankful to Dina and her awesome team for helping me throughout this journey! Dina is an excellent dog trainer and person, and her team are also great trainers/people.They all took wonderful care of Remy as she was learning the basics of puppyhood and socialization in the mindful pups two week puppy training. Its so important at this early stage in their development to have them exposed as much as possible in a safe environment, so this two week training was amazing for that, really a game changer.

I feel lucky to be able to bring Remy to Mindful daycare, where all the things she learned in the training are reinforced on a daily basis by the super nice, kind folks there.  Thank you Dina, Sam, Jazmine, and Fiona (to name a few:))) very highly recommend!
